purpose: Two connected governed Git LFS PDF stores. Every verified real PDF must be persisted to both before acquisition is considered successful.

storage_contract.source_failover: immediate next independent catalogued source on restriction/failure
storage_contract.no_source_quota: the engine does not stop after a provider-specific book count

activation.write_scope: repository contents read/write for the secondary storage repository

failure_policy: If either governed store cannot be reached or a verified PDF cannot be proven in both stores, the acquisition cycle fails closed rather than claiming persistence.
